title: Deterministic checks for Claude Code (opt-in)
description: Rule-based hooks and scripts, no model calls: a fast syntax/control-character check after each file edit, a done-check that sends Claude back once when it changed code after its last test or build, a cached project map at session start, a one-time push back on foreground sleep/poll waits, a once-per-turn reminder to delegate on long solo turns, a one-time refusal of re-reads of unchanged files, large tool results spilled to a file (path plus head and tail in context), a hook health note at session start, plus session-stats.mjs (per-session numbers for before/after comparisons) and safe-commit.mjs (commit after attribution, secret and private-pattern checks; terminal only).
postInstall: Claude checks: start a new Claude Code session to load the hooks. Tune the delegate reminder with CLAUDE_CHECKS_FANOUT_AT (default 40 tool calls) and the spill with CLAUDE_CHECKS_SPILL_AT (default 4000 characters), CLAUDE_CHECKS_READ_SPILL_AT (40000), CLAUDE_CHECKS_READ_SPILL_AT_SUBAGENT (15000; subagent Reads without an explicit offset/limit) and CLAUDE_CHECKS_SPILL_EXEMPT (tool-name regex); spilled outputs are kept 3 days in ~/.agents/cache/tool-output/. Grok CLI runs these hooks from ~/.claude/settings.json in folders it trusts: spill, shell-guard, read-guard and post-edit apply there too; done-check and the delegate reminder stay Claude-only (they read Claude's transcript). Opt out per project with .claude/checks-off, everywhere with CLAUDE_CHECKS=0. Project maps are cached in ~/.agents/cache/project-maps/. Scripts in ~/.agents/tools/checks/: hook-health.mjs (missing hook files, errors logged in ~/.agents/cache/hook-errors.log); session-stats.mjs [--days 7] [--project x]; safe-commit.mjs -F msg [-C repo] [--push] [--sign] (run in your own terminal; add private regexes to ~/.config/llm-config/private-patterns).
